Both hands are visibly relaxed down by the thighs, with small asymmetry; lower legs/feet are outside the original. source.json identifies Everlane and a 170 cm generic M user-authorized avatar prior, with model height and worn size unavailable. Original input SHA256 matches source.json. Retrieval provenance itself awaits transcript audit. Full TRACE/report/provenance now read: both explicitly use prior_avatar mode, no observed second view, model height and worn size unavailable. Input original hash eee08dde62e50376cc25fb2b46a59e8a83e5adf5a3f711d75743b0465e945897 matches the exact raw original referenced by every receipt. Source facts remain separate from avatar dimensions.

photo-render.png and views/front.png keep a reasonably upright neck/head and downward arms, broadly closer to input.jpg than B, but views/side.png exposes a backward-swept upper arm with elbow behind the torso line and a marked elbow bend before the vertical forearm. This is not the relaxed nearly straight arm gesture apparent in the photograph. The torso also arches/reclines relative to the pelvis; exact hidden sagittal shape is unknown. views/back.png shows near-level shoulders and stable pelvis but rigid extended fingers rather than the photographed relaxed curl. Hands sit very close to lateral thighs; no definitive penetration can be established from these renders. final-state.json includes lowerarm01.L -69.3 and lowerarm01.R -53.8 first-axis degrees, consistent with substantial bends; these are not observed human joint angles. Lower-leg stance is a prior completion, not photo evidence.

Both final-state.json files carry the boilerplate phrase Controlled synthetic anatomical fixture; this should describe the model fixture only, since input.jpg is a real retailer photo. Actual person centimetre accuracy and hidden shape remain UNKNOWN. Full report explicitly calls 0.000041 cm a numerical mesh calibration residual, not photograph measurement accuracy. Retained independent neutral reconstruction evidence matches named dimensions with ~1e-14 cm reconstruction differences and explicitly excludes posed/photo validation. The reviewer inspected this evidence without fitting or altering models.
